subject: "Selecting" a facet on a ggplot image

messages.author: deea3c30b4c8409f
messages.subject: "Selecting" a facet on a ggplot image
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to imitate the selection of a facet on a ggplot image. Once selected, the other facets on the same plot should "grey out". I am contemplating between the various possible ways (well, hacks) to accomplish this:

1) Create a whole new plot for each click. ggplot2 does not support colors per facet, so this would need a separate plot for each facet and putting them together with gtable. It would probably be a bit sluggish, because it takes a while to create the plot.

2) Get the facet coordinates in the browser somehow, and then grey out the rest of the image (well, facets) from JS. Is it possible to get the facet coordinates somehow?

3) Create a separate image for each facet. This simplifies the selection greatly, but I am a bit afraid the the big image (with all facet images) falls apart on some browsers. It also complicates the shiny R code somewhat.

Suggestions are welcome!
Gabor

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: "Selecting" a facet on a ggplot image
parts:
Hi Gabor -

I think if you wanted to do (1), you could use facets, and add a new geom_rect layer that shades out all the non-selected facets, with a reactive data source. You'd probably want to make the rectangles larger than the data, and then manually set the x and y scale limits.

It's theoretically possible to do option (2), since Shiny does send the coordinates for each facet to the browser, but I don't think there currently exist hooks to easily get that information. So you might be able to do it, but it would be ugly.

Good luck!
-Winston
